source: Verifier-written sample set used in t10 (scripts/t10-calibration.mjs). Frozen verbatim per t14 rule 1: entries and labels are NOT edited. Any disputed label is listed separately in docs/VERIFICATION_routing_v2.md instead of changed here.

labelRule.high: abstract / principle / design / planning; asks for judgement, not action
labelRule.mid: scoped edit on a named file, or analysis with concrete anchors (run tests + report, review file with scope)
labelRule.low: concrete execution: run/install/just-do-it; no per-file judgement required
